one_month_reasoning: The Q3 2026 report date is not confirmed by Reddit. MarketBeat says it is unconfirmed and estimates Thu Oct 29, which fits Reddit's pattern of reporting on the Thursday at month end (Q3'25 Oct 30, Q1'26 Apr 30, Q2'26 Jul 30). TipRanks and Investing.com list Wed Nov 4 after the close, which would put the gap outside the window. I put 55% on the earnings reaction landing inside the 2026-11-04 close. Reddit's base rate is a 10-20% earnings gap in either direction (Q2'26 about -21% then a +10% rebound; Q1'26 +13-16%), with no reliable sign: revenue beats of 10-11% over guide have not stopped selloffs driven by traffic and users. Other events in the window are two-sided: Alphabet/Meta prints around Oct 28-29, the Oct 28 FOMC, and Google licence headlines. S&P 500 inclusion already happened on 2026-08-18, so there is no index catalyst. The ladder is a 55/45 mixture of zero-drift lognormals around spot: sigma 21.5% when earnings fall in the window (16% diffusion plus a ~14% jump) and 15.5% when they do not. Median is spot, and there is no directional call.

fair_value.method: 65% P/E: NTM EPS at Oct-2027 of about $9.60 (0.25 x taxed CY27 adjusted $7.75 + 0.75 x taxed CY28 adjusted about $10.2) x 17.5x, the consistent-basis 11-peer median of 17.6x, gives $168. 35% SBC-adjusted FCF yield: NTM FCF of about $1.87B less SBC of about $0.65B is $5.9 a share; at a 4% yield that is $147, plus $13.5 a share of net cash, giving $160.5. The blend is $165.4, rounded to $165.

Yahoo, 29 analysts. It is almost untaxed: H1'26 tax was $5.7M on $462.6M pretax, under a full US valuation allowance.

US statutory rate. The 10-Q says a significant valuation-allowance release is reasonably possible within 12 months, which would move book tax to a normal rate. I taxed $9.69 x ~1.01 pretax at 21% to get $7.75. The supervisor's $8.2 implies about a 16% rate, which I do not adopt. Peers' adjusted EPS is taxed.

CY28 revenue of $5.45B (+22%, slowing from consensus +32% in CY27 as US DAUq growth runs at 6%). Adjusted pretax margin of 47% (Q3 guides an adjusted EBITDA margin of about 45%; CY27 consensus implies about 45-46%) gives $2.56B, plus about $0.12B of interest income, less 21% tax: $2.12B / 207M shares.
Kept flat: the $760M buyback offsets SBC dilution.

The median of 11 peers on CY2027 adjusted EPS (all December fiscal years) is 17.6x, range 4.9-38.8x. No premium, because the growth gap (32% vs about 13% peer revenue growth) is not shown to persist: Google traffic dependence, US DAUq flat QoQ, and the licence renewal.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: NTM FCF $1.87B - SBC $0.65B = $1.22B / 207M = $5.9 at a 4.0% yield = $147, + $13.5/share net cash

inputs_detail.derivation: 0.25 x CY27 ($4.46B x 36% = $1.6B) + 0.75 x CY28 ($5.45B x 36% = $1.96B). The 36% margin is Q2's 32% plus operating leverage.
SBC runs at about 12-13% of revenue. It is deducted so the yield is comparable with peers that expense SBC. This corrects my round-1 FCF, which did not adjust for SBC.
Mega-cap ad platforms trade at about 3-4% FCF yields. I use the top of that band for traffic-dependence risk and a hiking Fed, with no extra haircut, to avoid double counting.
I use today's balance rather than the roughly $3.5B projected at the horizon, because FCF already includes interest and the buyback consumes cash.

bear.story: Google cuts off referrals or the licence lapses (contracted licensing RPO is only $30.1M for 2027). US DAUq turns negative and 2027 revenue growth slows toward 20%, then the mid-teens in 2028. NTM EPS is about $7.3, valued at about 13x, between PINS/TTD and the peer median. This is the de-rating path TTD and PINS followed after growth scares.

base.story: The consensus path holds: about 32% revenue growth in 2027, slowing to about 22% in 2028, with mid-40s adjusted EBITDA margins. The licence is renewed without a step-change and a normal tax rate is adopted. 17.5x NTM taxed adjusted EPS of $9.60.

bull.story: Beats over guidance continue (10-11% in Q1/Q2), international monetization improves, and AI-licensing deals reprice upward, though well below the discounted $550M Wells Fargo scenario. NTM EPS is about $10.9 at about 22x, the GOOGL/META level, as growth proves durable. There is no S&P-inclusion leg: Reddit joined the index on 2026-08-18.

comps_summary.peer_range: CY2027 adjusted P/E of 4.9x (YELP) to 38.8x (ROKU) across 11 peers, all with December fiscal years and on one calendar-2027 consensus basis (prices 2026-10-05; SPOT EPS converted from EUR at 1.17). The interquartile range is about 10-23x. I verified PINS ($19.78/$2.40 = 8.2x) and ROKU ($153/$3.95 = 38.8x) on Yahoo. META, GOOGL, APP, SPOT, NFLX and DUOL use the supervisor's StockAnalysis figures, which are within 3% of my round-1 Yahoo figures. SNAP, TTD and YELP use the supervisor's EPS, with prices confirmed. The median is robust: it is 17.6x with or without ROKU and YELP. EV/EBITDA was not collected consistently, so I give no median.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: 17.5x on NTM taxed adjusted EPS, at the peer median. Today RDDT is 15.7x on untaxed CY27 adjusted EPS ($9.69) and 19.6x on taxed EPS ($7.75), about 11% above the median on a like-for-like taxed basis.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium or discount. RDDT's growth is far above the peers' (CY27 revenue +32% vs a median of about 13%), and it has a net-cash balance sheet. But I cannot show the growth gap persists through Oct 2027. Traffic depends on Google (10-Q cites search-algorithm effects on DAUq), US DAUq was flat QoQ, the logged-in/out disclosure is being dropped, only $30.1M of licensing revenue is contracted for 2027, and there is a class action on AI Overviews. So I apply the median.

thesis_break_reason: Below about $105, the stock would be at about 13.5x taxed CY27 adjusted EPS of $7.75 (about 12x excluding $13.5 a share of cash) and 12% under the 52-week low of $119.27. At that point the market is pricing growth falling to peer rates. That most likely reflects a fundamental break, such as sustained US DAUq declines, a Google referral or licence cut-off, or a guide-down, not ordinary 70%-vol noise. I moved from $100 to $105 because the taxed EPS base is lower than the untaxed one I used in round 1, so the same multiple maps to a similar price, and $105 sits just above my bear-scenario centre.

reasoning: Base-rates lane, round 2. I corrected the facts the supervisor flagged and verified them. (1) RDDT joined the S&P 500 effective 2026-08-18, replacing AvalonBay (S&P DJI release of 2026-08-13, CNBC; the supervisor dated it 08-14), so the inclusion catalyst and the bull leg are gone. Index-add drift is already in the price: the stock is down about 30% YTD despite inclusion. (2) The Q3 date is not confirmed by the company (MarketBeat), so I put 55% on the earnings gap landing inside the 1-month window. (3) Consensus EPS is almost untaxed. I tax it at 21% to get $7.75 for CY27 adjusted; the supervisor's $8.2 implies about a 16% rate, so I disagree. (4) The peer set is rebuilt on one CY27 adjusted basis with 11 peers: PINS added back (verified at 8.2x), SNAP, TTD and ROKU added, YELP corrected to the adjusted 4.9x. The median is 17.6x. Valuation: 17.5x NTM taxed EPS of $9.60 = $168, and the SBC-adjusted FCF yield at 4% = $160.5, blend $165. My NTM EPS ends close to the supervisor's ($9.65) despite the lower CY27 base, because my CY28 margin assumption is a little higher. Scenarios (bucket means): $95 / $168 / $240 at 27/48/25, a scenario-weighted mean of $166 that reconciles with the $165 fair value. Ladder: each scenario is a lognormal around its bucket mean with sigma 0.45/0.34/0.36, giving an overall log-sd of about 0.52. That is below the 70% trailing realized vol, which included a 21% earnings gap and an 11% index-add jump, but in line with base rates for de-rated, high-growth internet names (±35-50% a year). The resulting median is about $153 (P >= $152 = 0.51) and the mean is about $166. The gap between median and mean is lognormal skew, not a bearish tilt. Limits: StockAnalysis 2027 columns are paywalled to me, so SNAP, TTD, YELP and several large-cap peer EPS figures rely on the supervisor's comps_review, cross-checked where possible against Yahoo (PINS, ROKU and my round-1 Yahoo data). I found no Reddit-specific prediction market.
